description: Deionized water: DSMZ 533 names H2O (deionized) in the main medium and trace stock, each as 1000 ml water. The identity retains the specified deionization treatment only: no resistivity, purity class, sterility or distillation claim. Water is not decomposed into a molecular-water component because treatment grade is not partonomy.
identity_predicate_alias_consequences: New source-qualified registry identity; no exact/broad mapping to its solute, no global raw source alias and no automatic whole-case resolution. Typed components describe only asserted parts.
publication_review_obligations: Independent source/payload review and coordinator duplicate/preparation comparison required. All source-specific holds remain. Native schema/partonomy and full-owner review must precede maintained integration.
cross_shard_conflict: Coordinator must compare existing campaign candidate owners by actual preparation, not label or concentration alone. Distinct source context alone does not establish a distinct substance; consolidate where actual same preparation is demonstrated.
applicability: Only the named primary preparation in these linked cases; source-local identity and component scope remain explicit.
